short_description: Recurring memory leaks in authentication service
description: Authentication service has experienced 5 memory-related outages in the past 30 days. Each time the service is restarted as a workaround but root cause has not been permanently fixed.
symptoms: out of memory errors, service crashes every 5-7 days, gradual memory growth
root_cause_notes: Suspected memory leak in session token cache. Investigation ongoing.
work_notes: Heap dumps collected on 3 occasions. Analysis points to unbounded session cache growth. Ticket raised with vendor.
